decisions.reason: Selecting Transak as the fiat on-ramp does not change the separate Brevo transactional-email provider or delivery behavior.
The fiat on-ramp provider change does not alter SIWE authentication or the wallet-based flows protected by it.
Transak replaces the fiat payment provider, but the source does not change magic-link authentication, dashboard access, or supported non-crypto users.
The occurrence of the word mint in a badge name is incidental; the fiat provider decision does not change the badge set or presentation.
Changing the fiat on-ramp provider does not change the amount or automatic distribution of coded-referral commissions.
The source selects a fiat provider but does not alter ticket recipients or ticket quantities for referral mints.
The fiat provider selection does not alter ticket allocation or random-recipient selection for no-referral mints.
The choice of Transak for fiat onboarding does not change Chainlink VRF winner selection.
The fiat provider change does not affect the ticket counters or permanent badges represented in NFT metadata.
Selecting Transak does not change the unauthenticated access policy or information exposed by public APIs.
The fiat on-ramp provider decision does not modify secondary-sale royalty enforcement.
